title: Transition from the bit state
statement: For any Boolean word $x$, output word $u$, natural number $i$, and Boolean oracle $o$ on encoded Boolean words, one step of the enumerator from the configuration with output $u$, state holding a bit, and counter $i$ leaves the output and counter unchanged and enters the state that emits true if $o(1,\langle x,\operatorname{bits}(i)\rangle)$ is true, and the state that emits false otherwise.
